自動做市商再平衡研究

Automated Market Maker Rebalancing Research

創辦人研發經歷 · 工程評估

在歷史資料中比較流動性部位的再平衡模型，以固定基準和按時間切分的測試降低比較偏差。

建立專案需求

產業問題與工程挑戰

自動做市商的流動性部位隨市場價格改變，比較再平衡決策時需要固定資料期間和實驗條件。 策略的歷史模擬容易受資料切分、基準選擇與交易成本假設影響。比較的適用範圍依賴這些條件。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

公開研究比較量子自適應自注意力模組與多組對照。論文描述 2024 年 1 月至 2025 年 1 月的歷史日資料，並依時間分為訓練、驗證與測試集。

成果

已公開方法與歷史模擬比較，可按論文中的資料期間、基準和交易設定解讀。

  • 公開研究論文與比較方法
  • 可核對的資料期間、時間切分與基準說明

驗證與證據

評估範圍是論文所述歷史市場與模擬條件。基準及交易設定應回到論文查驗，頁面未列出可套用於其他資產的報酬數字。

公開論文

公開 AMM 再平衡研究

作者在同一歷史期間比較混合量子經典模型與多組基準。來源提供資料切分和回測條件。

Technical Note

Automated Market Maker Rebalancing Research

Founder Engineering Experience · Engineering Evaluation

Compare liquidity-position rebalancing models on historical data using fixed baselines and time-ordered testing.

繁體中文 Plan a project

Industry problem and engineering challenge

The composition of automated market maker liquidity positions changes with market prices. Comparing rebalancing decisions requires a defined period and shared test conditions. Historical strategy simulations depend on the data split, choice of baselines and transaction-cost assumptions. Those conditions bound the comparison.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The public study compares a quantum adaptive self-attention module with several controls. It describes daily history from January 2024 through January 2025 and a chronological training, validation and test split.

Outcome

The publication provides methods and a historical simulation comparison with a documented period, baselines and trading assumptions.

  • Public paper and comparison method
  • Documented data period, chronological split and baselines

Validation and evidence

The evaluation applies to the market history and simulation conditions reported in the paper. The publication describes its baselines and trading setup. The page publishes no return figure for other assets.

Published research

Public AMM rebalancing research

The authors compare a hybrid quantum-classical model with multiple baselines over the same historical period. The source documents the split and simulation conditions.

Open evidence and method
  • Public paper · Automated market maker rebalancing
  • IEEE ICASSP 2026 · Presentation program

Project status and disclosure

Ownership and status
Founder Engineering Experience · Engineering Evaluation

The founder co-authored the public study. This page describes the research design and historical simulation. Trading records, client data and actual asset positions are outside its scope.
